notes: Product is the EEG Enterprises HD492 iCap SDI Closed Caption Encoder (1RU). EEG Enterprises is now part of Ai-Media / operates under Access Innovation IP Pty Ltd; the current official manual is hosted at ai-media.tv. Primary source used: official HD492 iCap Encoder User Manual (Ai-Media, rev. March 15 2023), specifically the "Rear Panel," "Encoder Specs," and "GPIO Pinout" sections (pp. 30-37), cross-checked against the EEG/Ai-Media iCap Encoder datasheet PDF. Dimensions conflict between sources: the marketing datasheet states 19" x 1RU x 25" deep while the (more current/detailed) manual's Encoder Specs table states 19" x 1RU x 16.5" deep — the manual figure was used. GP In/GP Out are physically 16-pin headers (mate to Omron XG5N-161-U) carrying 8 GPI + 8 GPO channels respectively; no listed connector id matches this, so "euroblock" was used as the closest approximation — treat with caution if exact connector fit matters. Modem A/B ports are physically RJ-11 (6P4C) jacks; "rj45" was used as the closest listed connector id since RJ-11 is not in the allowed list. SDI output grade (sdi-3g) was inferred from the relay-bypass pass-through design matching the 3G/HD/SD-capable SDI inputs; the output spec table did not restate a Format row separately. AC inlet connector variant (IEC C13/C14 vs other) is not explicitly named in either source document — inferred from standard broadcast rack-gear convention. Could not find a B&H/Sweetwater/Markertek/Crutchfield listing for this professional broadcast-only product, so the manufacturer's own manual/datasheet was used as the sole authoritative source.

ports.name: Master Video In
ports.note: Program SDI input; accepts 3G (SMPTE 424M), HD (SMPTE 292M), or SD (SMPTE 259M/344M)

ports.name: Video Out 2
ports.note: Non-relay-bypass copy of primary video output (Master copy)

ports.name: Decoder Out
ports.note: Relay-bypass protected Auxiliary SDI output; also serves as open-caption decoder monitor output

ports.name: Time Code In
ports.note: Balanced audio input for LTC time code (used by CCPlay feature)

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Female XLR; balanced analog or AES3 (110-ohm digital, 48kHz PCM) companion program audio for iCap

ports.name: USB Port (Front)
ports.note: Firmware update / VANC capture via USB flash drive

ports.name: USB Port (Rear)
ports.note: Two USB-A jacks present on rear panel under this label (3 USB ports total on unit)

ports.name: Serial Port 1 (333/GA Out)
ports.note: DB-9, selectable RS-232C/RS-422; also supports 708 caption data

ports.name: Modem A
ports.note: Actual jack is RJ-11 (6P4C); rj45 chosen as closest listed connector. Standard/installed modem for dial-up captioning

ports.name: Modem B
ports.note: Actual jack is RJ-11 (6P4C); rj45 chosen as closest listed connector. Optional add-on second modem, paid option

ports.name: GP In
ports.note: Actual connector is a 16-pin header mating an Omron XG5N-161-U receptacle (8 optocoupler GPI inputs), not a true euroblock terminal block; euroblock chosen as closest listed connector type

ports.name: GP Out
ports.note: Actual connector is a 16-pin header mating an Omron XG5N-161-U receptacle (8 normally-open relay GPO outputs, 2A/30VDC), not a true euroblock terminal block; euroblock chosen as closest listed connector type

ports.name: AC Power Source
ports.note: 115/230V AC 50/60Hz, tolerant 120-240V. Exact IEC inlet variant (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in source docs; inferred from standard 1RU broadcast-gear convention
